root.label: Trump taps Charles Neil Floyd for Western Washington U.S. attorney

events.label: Trump taps Charles Neil Floyd for Western Washington U.S. attorney

slots.name: appointment date
slots.sentence: Trump tapped Floyd for the position in October 2025.

events.label: Charles Neil Floyd's interim U.S. attorney term expires

slots.name: interim term limit
slots.sentence: Floyd's term ended only four months after being appointed because Trump did not formally nominate him, instead appointing him as interim attorney (with a term limit of 120 days, per US Code 546, that ended on Feb. 3, 2026) then as first assistant U.S. attorney.
